title: Correctness: DO_SIGN/DO_AGREE accept SYMMETRIC key fds, return wrong errno
description:
Trigger: open() fd1 → write(ikm) → DO_KDF (fd1 becomes SYMMETRIC KEY fd) → open() fd2 → ioctl(fd2, DO_SIGN, {key_fd=fd1, ...}).

In ioctl_do_sign (crypto2dev_fd.c ~line 1147), after validating key_state->fd_type == FDTYPE_KEY, the only key_type check is:
  if (key_state->key_type == CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_PUBLIC) → -EBADF

key_type == CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_SYMMETRIC (4) is not CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_PUBLIC (2), so it passes. The code then reaches:
  if (!key_state->key_ops->sign) → -EOPNOTSUPP

crypto2dev_sym_key_ops has sign=NULL, so -EOPNOTSUPP is returned.

Documented API contract (DO_SIGN header): returns -EBADF if key_fd is not a valid KEY fd with a private key. A SYMMETRIC key fd is not a private key; -EOPNOTSUPP is wrong. Callers that check for -EBADF to detect invalid key fd will incorrectly interpret -EOPNOTSUPP as 'algorithm does not support signing' rather than 'wrong fd type'.

Same defect in ioctl_do_agree: SYMMETRIC key type passes the KEY_PUBLIC check, then key_ops->agree is NULL → -EOPNOTSUPP instead of -EBADF.

The fix is to add a check rejecting key_type == CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_SYMMETRIC (and any other non-asymmetric type) alongside the KEY_PUBLIC check in both ioctl_do_sign and ioctl_do_agree.
close_reason: Changed key_type == KEY_PUBLIC to key_type \!= KEY_PRIVATE in DO_SIGN and DO_AGREE; SYMMETRIC key fds now correctly return -EBADF instead of -EOPNOTSUPP
